name: Park Hotel

overview: The Park Hotel is just off the main road in Thurso, about a ten-minute walk from the station and close to the town centre. It has 20 en-suite bedrooms, including one adapted for disabled guests, plus a bar and restaurant. Breakfast and parking are included.
surfTripFit: Off-street parking and an in-house restaurant keep things simple between sessions on Thurso's town beach.
